title: Understanding Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves taking random samples with replacement from a dataset. This means each sample can have repeated entries from the original dataset. Think about how this might affect the size of your sample.

title: Identifying the Percentile
text: Percentiles are used to determine the relative standing of a value within a dataset. The lower percentile often used in confidence intervals is $$2.5\%$$. Consider why this might be the case.
